name: docs
about: Technical writing: code with a file name, diffs, formulas, file trees and cited sources.

Code.about: a fenced code block inside, shown with its file name and highlighted lines

Diff.about: a change, from the fenced diff block inside (lines starting with + and -)

FileTree.about: files and folders, one list item per path, folders ending in /

Citation.about: a source the answer relies on; what it says between the tags
